summary.plain: A shielded corridor next to the neutron-producing target of the Spallation Neutron Source at Oak Ridge, Tennessee, used to detect neutrinos produced as a byproduct of the neutron beam.
summary.technical: 'Neutrino Alley': a shielded basement hallway adjacent to the SNS liquid-mercury spallation target, exploited as a pion/muon-decay-at-rest neutrino source for CEvNS experiments (e.g. COHERENT); no official coordinate found in this session (see note).
